candidate.rationale: Fix empty-history check: recentCount must no longer be bounded by history.length (an empty history with recentCount=1 is valid and returns []). Bound recentCount to [0, 12] instead, keeping all other validation (unique tool-call ids, positional pairing) and masking semantics unchanged.
Restore slice-bounds handling: reject interior surrogate-pair start offsets and move an interior end backward to avoid splitting a pair, preserving exports, validation, and return fields.

Structural comparison: canonicalize keys (sorted) recursively while preserving array order, so object member order is ignored but types, array order, missing/extra members remain significant; keeps response_not_text and invalid_json reasons and only returns exact_json_match on equal parsed values.

Replace stringified-JSON comparison (key-order-sensitive and breaks on nested objects) with isDeepStrictEqual structural deep equality, preserving response_not_text/invalid_json reasons and exact_json_match/answer_mismatch semantics.

Fix the start-boundary failure: reject offsets that land inside a surrogate pair (throwing inspection-range-splits-unicode), e.g. ["xy😀z",3,2]. The end-boundary backoff and no-progress check already handle ["xy😀z",0,3]→"xy" and ["😀",0,1]→error, and remain unchanged. Export and unrelated behavior preserved.

Restore evidence/cases.json requirements: tool call IDs must be unique within each exchange, and each tool result must match the assistant call at the same positional index (not mere membership). Masking and export behavior unchanged.
